scenarios.name: exiles-from-top-until-total-mana-value-four-then-casts-free-and-exiles-itself
scenarios.why: The top card (Craw Wurm, mana value 6) already reaches total mana value 4 or greater, so only it is exiled and the Forest below it is never revealed. That exiled card may then be cast without paying its mana cost, so the 6/4 enters the battlefield with no mana spent, and the Paradigm rider exiles the resolved Capstone.

scenarios.name: paradigm-free-copy-at-the-next-first-main-phase
scenarios.why: The exiled Capstone is a free castable copy at the beginning of its owner's next first main phase (702.168b): the offer appears with no mana in the pool, and casting it costs nothing. It resolves the same way (exiling down to total mana value 4 or greater; the top card at that point is a land, so no spell is castable) and its own Paradigm rider returns it to exile.
